sentences.en: It started with a whistleblower's complaint about President Trump's contact with a foreign leader.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于一名举报人对特朗普总统与外国领导人接触的投诉。

sentences.en: I had a perfect phone call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我与乌克兰总统进行了一次完美的通话。

sentences.en: Like, I mean, perfect.
sentences.zh: 我是说，非常完美。

sentences.en: Today, I am asking our chairman to proceed with articles of impeachment.
sentences.zh: 今天，我要求我们的主席着手起草弹劾条款。

sentences.en: You need to call balls and strikes the right way.
sentences.zh: 你们需要以正确的方式来裁决好球和坏球。

sentences.en: You don't interrupt either one of them, chairman.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，你不能打断他们任何一方的发言。

sentences.en: You're your questioner or the witness.
sentences.zh: 无论是提问者还是证人。

sentences.en: Bang it harder.
sentences.zh: 敲得再响一点。

sentences.en: It still doesn't make the point that you're not doing it right.
sentences.zh: 这依然无法证明你做得不对。

sentences.en: It's Julie Davis in the Washington Bureau of the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》华盛顿分社的朱莉·戴维斯。

sentences.en: Today, the House Judiciary Committee took the next step in building an impeachment case against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 今天，众议院司法委员会在针对唐纳德·特朗普的弹劾案中迈出了下一步。

sentences.en: As they worked toward drafting articles of impeachment, they heard from attorneys who work for the two congressional committees leading this charge.
sentences.zh: 在他们着手起草弹劾条款之际，他们听取了为负责此项指控的两个国会委员会工作的律师们的陈述。

sentences.en: We will hear 30-minute opening arguments from councils for the majority and the minority of this committee.
sentences.zh: 我们将听取本委员会多数党和少数党法律顾问各30分钟的开场陈述。

sentences.en: Lawyers from the Judiciary Committee, which has been thinking about impeachment for months.
sentences.zh: 来自司法委员会的律师们，他们已经研究弹劾问题好几个月了。

sentences.en: Then we will hear 45-minute presentations of evidence from majority and minority counsel from the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们将听取常设情报特别委员会多数党和少数党法律顾问各45分钟的证据陈述。

sentences.en: And from the Intelligence Committee, which wrapped up its work last week investigating this Ukraine matter.
sentences.zh: 还有来自情报委员会的律师，该委员会上周结束了对乌克兰问题的调查工作。

sentences.en: They're recapping for the Judiciary Committee everything that's come out of the hearing so far.
sentences.zh: 他们正在为司法委员会总结迄今为止听证会中出现的所有情况。

sentences.en: So the committee can figure out if they can translate that into actual articles of impeachment, and if so, what they should say.
sentences.zh: 这样委员会就能确定是否能将其转化为实际的弹劾条款，如果可以，应该如何表述。

sentences.en: Mr. Burke is recognized.
sentences.zh: 伯克先生获准发言。

sentences.en: Steamroll continues.
sentences.zh: 强行推进还在继续。

sentences.en: Mr. Burke has the floor.
sentences.zh: 伯克先生拥有发言权。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman, Ranking Member Collins, and all the members.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生、首席共和党议员柯林斯，以及各位委员。

sentences.en: There was Barry Burke, the lawyer who's been working with Judiciary since February, to investigate whether Trump abused his power and obstructed justice.
sentences.zh: 巴里·伯克律师自二月以来一直与司法委员会合作，调查特朗普是否滥用职权和妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: He started with this anecdote about his young son as a way to boil this whole investigation down.
sentences.zh: 他以关于他年幼儿子的轶事作为开场，以此来概括整个调查的核心。

sentences.en: Before I had the great honor of being a counsel for this committee, my young son asked me a question.
sentences.zh: 在我获得担任本委员会法律顾问的殊荣之前，我年幼的儿子问了我一个问题。

sentences.en: He said, Dad, does the president have to be a good person?
sentences.zh: 他说，爸爸，总统必须是一个好人吗？

sentences.en: Like many questions by young children, it had a certain clarity, but it was hard to answer.
sentences.zh: 像许多孩子提出的问题一样，它有一种清晰感，但却很难回答。

sentences.en: I said, son, it is not a requirement that the president be a good person, but that is the hope.
sentences.zh: 我说，儿子，总统并不一定要是个好人，但那是人们的期盼。

sentences.en: It is a requirement that the president be a person who does not abuse his power.
sentences.zh: 但总统必须是一个不滥用职权的人。

sentences.en: And if you're discussing this with a kid, the simplest explanation is that the president can be a bad guy.
sentences.zh: 如果你和孩子讨论这个问题，最简单的解释就是总统也可能是个坏人。

sentences.en: That's not what this is about, Burke says.
sentences.zh: 伯克说，这并不是问题的关键。

sentences.en: But he can't be a corrupt person, somebody putting his own interests ahead of the country's interests.
sentences.zh: 但他不能是一个腐败的人，不能是一个将个人利益置于国家利益之上的人。

sentences.en: It is a requirement that the president not be a person who acts as though he is above the law in putting his personal and political interests above the nation's interests.
sentences.zh: 总统必须是一个不凌驾于法律之上，不将个人和政治利益置于国家利益之上的人。

sentences.en: That is the lesson of the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 这就是宪法的教训。

sentences.en: That is the lesson of the founders.
sentences.zh: 这就是开国元勋们的教训。

sentences.en: And then the committee also heard from Daniel Goldman, who's the Democratic lawyer on the House Intelligence Committee, which has been investigating the Ukraine affair.
sentences.zh: 随后，委员会还听取了众议院情报委员会民主党律师丹尼尔·戈德曼的陈述，该委员会一直在调查乌克兰事件。

sentences.en: Mr. Goldman, you may begin.
sentences.zh: 戈德曼先生，你可以开始了。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢主席先生。

sentences.en: And he has sort of the line of the day about how the president's ongoing efforts to get a foreign country's help in his reelection effort amounted to what he called a clear and present danger to our free and fair elections and to our national security.
sentences.zh: 他提出了当天最核心的观点，即总统为谋求连任而持续寻求外国帮助的行为，构成了他所称的对我们自由公正选举及国家安全的现实而紧迫的威胁。

sentences.en: That's just the starkest way you can put that.
sentences.zh: 这是你能表达出的最直白的说法了。

sentences.en: The overwhelming evidence of this scheme is described in detail in a nearly 300-page document entitled The Trump-Ukraine Impeachment Inquiry Report,
sentences.zh: 这一阴谋的压倒性证据在题为《特朗普-乌克兰弹劾调查报告》的近300页文件中得到了详细描述，

sentences.en: formerly transmitted from the House Permanent Selecting Committee on Intelligence to this committee a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 该报告于几天前由众议院常设情报特别委员会正式移交给本委员会。

sentences.en: But the latest and the thing that jumped out at me is what didn't come up much at this hearing, which gives us a clue about what's coming next.
sentences.zh: 但最新且最令我关注的是听证会上并未过多提及的内容，这为我们提供了接下来会发生什么的线索。

sentences.en: There's been this behind-the-scenes debate among Democrats over how broad to make the articles of impeachment, stick to the Ukraine stuff,
sentences.zh: 民主党内部一直在进行幕后辩论，讨论弹劾条款的范围应该有多大，是仅限于乌克兰问题，

sentences.en: or broaden it out to include whether the president obstructed justice when he tried to shut down Bob Mueller's investigation into Russian interference in the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 还是扩大到包括总统在试图阻止鲍勃·穆勒调查俄罗斯干预2016年大选时是否妨碍了司法公正。

sentences.en: The Mueller report laid out all these instances of potential obstruction, some of them pretty clear-cut.
sentences.zh: 穆勒报告列举了所有潜在的妨碍司法实例，其中一些非常明确。

sentences.en: And the question for Democrats now is, as long as we're going down the road of impeachment,
sentences.zh: 现在民主党面临的问题是，既然我们已经走上了弹劾之路，

sentences.en: do we pick up where Mueller left off or jettison all that work and just focus on Ukraine?
sentences.zh: 我们是该从穆勒留下的地方继续，还是抛弃所有那些工作，只专注于乌克兰问题？

sentences.en: The integrity of our next election is at stake.
sentences.zh: 我们下一次选举的公正性正处于危险之中。

sentences.en: Nothing could be more urgent.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比这更紧迫的了。

sentences.en: And we got a big clue here that it'll be the latter.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里得到了一个重要的线索，即会选择后者。

sentences.en: Yes, there was some mention of Russian interference, broad allusions to it.
sentences.zh: 是的，确实提到了俄罗斯的干预，并进行了广泛的影射。

sentences.en: Both Burke and Jerry Nadler, the Judiciary Committee chairman, said there's a pattern here of the president actively seeking help in elections.
sentences.zh: 伯克和司法委员会主席杰里·纳德勒都表示，总统在选举中积极寻求帮助已形成了一种模式。

sentences.en: The president welcomed foreign interference in our elections in 2016.
sentences.zh: 总统在2016年欢迎外国干预我们的选举。

sentences.en: He demanded it for 2020.
sentences.zh: 他在2020年又对此提出了要求。

sentences.en: Then he got caught.
sentences.zh: 然后他被抓住了。

sentences.en: This pattern of conduct represents a continuing risk to the country.
sentences.zh: 这种行为模式对国家构成了持续的风险。

sentences.en: But it seems to be there for context, not as the predicate for bringing a separate actual article of impeachment on obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 但这似乎只是为了提供背景，而不是作为提出妨碍司法公正这一独立弹劾条款的前提。

sentences.en: Now, it may still figure into the articles of impeachment in some way, maybe rolled into a charge about obstruction of congressional investigations, including the Ukraine matter.
sentences.zh: 当然，它仍可能以某种方式出现在弹劾条款中，或许会被纳入关于妨碍国会调查（包括乌克兰问题）的指控中。

sentences.en: But right now, given the testimony we heard today about Barry Burke telling his son a president can't abuse his power, about the danger to our elections,
sentences.zh: 但就目前而言，考虑到今天听到的证词，关于巴里·伯克告诉他儿子总统不能滥用职权，关于对我们选举的威胁，

sentences.en: about the danger to national security, it seems like Democrats are going to keep impeachment tightly focused, as many of their more moderate members are asking them to.
sentences.zh: 关于对国家安全的威胁，民主党人似乎会保持弹劾的重点，正如他们许多温和派成员所要求的那样。

sentences.en: So that's the latest from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这就是华盛顿的最新消息。

sentences.en: Next, the House Judiciary Committee will propose its articles of impeachment and reconvene as early as Wednesday to debate and vote to send them to the full House.
sentences.zh: 接下来，众议院司法委员会将提出其弹劾条款，并最早于周三重新开会进行辩论和投票，以将其提交给众议院全体会议。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在任何你收听播客的地方订阅收听。
